articles.title: Trump family's World Liberty Financial delay plans to sell Maldives resort token
articles.summary: The token’s sale has been pushed back due to the Iran war disrupting travel in the region.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips as U.S. inflation fails to spark gains, ETFs see August's first two-day drawdown
articles.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs saw back-to-back outflows for the first time since late July as the largest cryptocurrency wiped out last week's gains and altcoins struggled to find direction.

articles.title: 時隔20年，台灣前總統陳水扁女兒陳幸妤再次成為媒體焦點
articles.summary: 台灣前總統陳水扁的女兒陳幸妤，近日因離婚一事曝光，時隔多年再次成為了台灣輿論焦點，也引起社會反思20年前媒體追訪她的倫理問題。

articles.title: Feds probe 'mention markets.' And, lawmakers call for investigation into USS Lincoln
articles.summary: Federal regulators are reviewing 'mention markets' that allow wagers on what public figures will say. And, Democratic lawmakers call for an investigation into conditions on the long-deployed USS Lincoln.
